Item 1. Business

Item 1A. Risk Factors

We face competition from integrated software vendors that bundle payment processing with vertical software, which has intensified competition for our direct sales channel and may result in the loss of merchant relationships to platforms that own the point-of-sale relationship. We face competition from integrated software vendors that bundle payment processing with vertical software, which has intensified competition for our direct sales channel and may result in the loss of merchant relationships to platforms that own the point-of-sale relationship.

Our take rate declined during the year, reflecting a shift in mix toward larger merchants with lower negotiated pricing, and continued pricing pressure could further compress our revenue yield on processed volume. Our take rate declined during the year, reflecting a shift in mix toward larger merchants with lower negotiated pricing, and continued pricing pressure could further compress our revenue yield on processed volume.

We rely on sponsor bank relationships to access the card networks, and the loss of a sponsor bank relationship would disrupt our ability to process transactions until an alternative arrangement could be established. We rely on sponsor bank relationships to access the card networks, and the loss of a sponsor bank relationship would disrupt our ability to process transactions until an alternative arrangement could be established.
